sehemu: Part III: Procedure, Powers and Privileges of Parliament
jina: Standing Orders of the National Assembly
maudhui: (1) Subject to the provisions of this Constitution, the National Assembly may make Standing Orders for regulating the procedure for the conduct of its business. (2) Standing Orders made pursuant to this Article may provide for the procedure for supervising the work of the Secretariat of the National Assembly and for the conduct of the business of the National Assembly in the House and in its committees and subcommittees.
